why: Bolbachan 2024 is the only event that settles part of the literal statement: the cohomology of Γ(F,m) in degree m−1 for all weights over characteristic-zero fields, a restriction of the conjecture (case), unreviewed since KRS only cite and compare it. The KRS papers prove statements about their Lie coalgebra G(F), not Γ(F,n); the authors themselves call the weight-3 result a 'variant', its degree-2 part duplicates Bolbachan, and the number-field paper never connects G(F) to Γ(F,n) beyond n = 3, so both are variant. Charlton (depth conjecture), Kimura (conditional, different target), Rudenko 2015 and Bolbachan 2021 (strong Suslin reciprocity) are different Goncharov conjectures; Gangl, Aoki and Goncharov–Rudenko settle nothing of the cohomology statement in the text read. No AI system is named anywhere.
doubts: The statement is a vague stub; the reading of it as the Γ(F,n) cohomology conjecture follows the record. Whether Bolbachan's quasi-isomorphism is degree-wise across all fields was not fully confirmed, and the Annals version of Goncharov–Rudenko was not checked for a proof of the weight-4 Conjecture 1.4. If G(F) were shown equivalent to Γ(F,n), KRS 2608 would become a case (number fields).
